preview_gate.bootstrap: uv pip install --system -r tests/e2e/requirements.txt && playwright install chromium
preview_gate.run: BASE_URL="$INFRA2_HOOK_APP_URL" bash tools/smoke_test.sh && eval "$(python tools/test_selection.py --stage preview_minimum_e2e --shell)" && pytest "${PREVIEW_MINIMUM_E2E_TESTS[@]}" -v --tb=short -o addopts="" -m "$PREVIEW_MINIMUM_E2E_MARKER" && eval "$(python tools/test_selection.py --touched-files ${INFRA2_TOUCHED_FILES:-} --shell)" && ( [ ${#TOUCHED_E2E_TESTS[@]} -eq 0 ] || pytest "${TOUCHED_E2E_TESTS[@]}" -v --tb=short -o addopts="" -m "$TOUCHED_E2E_MARKER" )

staging_gate.bootstrap: uv pip install --system -r tests/e2e/requirements.txt && playwright install chromium
staging_gate.run: BASE_URL="$INFRA2_HOOK_APP_URL" bash tools/smoke_test.sh && eval "$(python tools/test_selection.py --stage staging_core_e2e --shell)" && pytest "${STAGING_CORE_E2E_TESTS[@]}" -v --tb=short -o addopts="" -m "$STAGING_CORE_E2E_MARKER" && pytest tests/e2e/test_ai_provider_connectivity.py -v --tb=short -o addopts="" && eval "$(python tools/test_selection.py --stage staging_ai_ocr --corpus canary --shell)" && pytest "${STAGING_AI_OCR_TESTS[@]}" -v --tb=short -o addopts="" -m "$STAGING_AI_OCR_MARKER"

scheduled_audit.bootstrap: uv pip install --system -r tests/e2e/requirements.txt && playwright install chromium
scheduled_audit.run: eval "$(python tools/test_selection.py --stage staging_ai_ocr --corpus audit_replay --shell)" && pytest "${STAGING_AI_OCR_TESTS[@]}" -v --tb=short -o addopts="" -m "$STAGING_AI_OCR_MARKER" && eval "$(python tools/test_selection.py --stage staging_ai_ocr --corpus core_journey --shell)" && pytest "${STAGING_AI_OCR_TESTS[@]}" -v --tb=short -o addopts="" -m "$STAGING_AI_OCR_MARKER"
